response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT constructorId, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM constructorStandings GROUP BY constructorId), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM counts) SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, counts.record_count, counts.record_count - average_count.avg_count AS difference_from_average FROM counts JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = counts.constructorId CROSS JOIN average_count WHERE counts.record_count > average_count.avg_count ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, c.constructorId LIMIT 10
